title: Know who decides local-machine access
need: System privacy database reads are refused by Yoke; broad home discovery is advisory. Live reads inside registered machine checkouts are exempt after symlink containment checks; missing or unreadable config grants no exemption. Personal-folder reads and GUI automation remain subject to harness permissions and OS controls. Automated-test isolation is stricter than live policy.
surface: Local privacy guard diagnosis names authority and a recovery step.
gap: The refusal teaching is concrete; proactive human help entry and end-to-end delivery outside project context were not traced.
